create_RotatedBoxes: create a RotatedBoxes instance from a Nx5 tensor with x_center, y_center, width, height, angle
compute_RotatedBoxes_area: compute the area of all rotated boxes in a RotatedBoxes tensor
clip_RotatedBoxes: clip near-horizontal rotated boxes to fit within an image boundary of given height and width
scale_RotatedBoxes: scale rotated boxes by horizontal and vertical factors and approximate the resulting shape
compute_pairwise_iou: compute the intersection over union between all pairs of two RotatedBoxes lists
